summary: Appeal: Partial credits missing after hourly accumulator rollback during mixed-quantization batch run
description: Issue summary: Percepta Labs reports they did not receive a partial credit for an hourly accumulator rollback that occurred during a mixed-quantization batch job on 2026-03-09 23:00-23:15 UTC. Impact: Customer expects ~$1,200 in prorated credits to be applied to their month-to-date invoice; currently the invoice shows full charge and no provisional credit. Environment: prod (us-west-2), dedicated tenant, reserved capacity + burst pool. Steps to reproduce: 1) Run mixed-quantization batch (jobs using rw-open-3b-v1 and gptx-compat-7b-quant) with autoscale policy set to allow burst. 2) Trigger manual scheduler rollback of hourly accumulator (internal operator action). 3) Observe billing postback window and invoice generated on March 10. Expected: Metering service deducts prorated hours/credits for the rolled back accumulator window. Observed: No credit applied; usage shows full token counts for the affected hourly window. Logs/IDs: tenant_id=percepta-34, job_ids=[J-9876, J-9877], postback_batch_id=PB-20260309-23, invoice_line_ref=INV-202603-Percepta-01. Additional context: Customer had previously received partial credits for similar rollbacks (SUP-721345). They raised this as an urgent credit appeal ahead of their EOM reconciliation.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Sofia Nguyen (Support): Thanks for the report — we've acknowledged and set P1. Gathering usage export and escalation to billing eng.
2026-03-10 - Percepta Support Rep (customer): Confirmed invoice shows full charge. Can you provide ETA for provisional credit?

2026-03-11 - Ethan Chen (Billing Eng): We can reproduce missing credit on postback consumer when an accumulator rollback overlaps a mixed-quantization microbatch boundary. Opening infra investigation. Marked related PR for telemetry: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4182.

2026-03-12 - Sofia Nguyen (Support): Customer updated they need the credit applied before next billing run. Escalated to finance for manual adjustment if engineering cannot complete automated fix in 48h.
investigation_notes: Checked postback logs for PB-20260309-23: consumer accepted events but metric 'accumulator.rollback' had timestamp drift of ~90s relative to batch window, causing it to fall into next hourly bucket.

Hypothesis: Hourly accumulator logic aggregates by fixed-window boundaries; rollback events with timestamp drift were not re-associated with the original bucket for crediting. Mixed-quantization microbatches produce non-deterministic commit timing, increasing chance of boundary drift.

Query run: SELECT * FROM metering.postbacks WHERE batch_id='PB-20260309-23' returns two entries for job J-9876; second entry had corrected_token_count but no rollback_flag set — possible duplicate event overwrote rollback-tagged record.
Related code area: metering consumer dedup + accumulator assignment (infra/metering/consumer.go). PR 4182 adds extra telemetry but does not fully address re-association logic.
resolution_notes: Workaround applied 2026-03-12: Manually created provisional credit for Percepta Labs ($1,210.00) applied to account as a refund line item; finance notified and invoice INV-202603-Percepta-01 updated. Engineering action: follow-up ticket INT-330112 created to implement idempotent rollback re-association and timestamp-normalization for accumulator events. Planned rollout: patch to postback consumer (infra PR in review) and acceptance test covering mixed-quantization microbatch boundaries. Customer notified and confirmed acceptance of provisional credit; monitoring added to track similar rollbacks for 7 days.
